_about: Learner-facing extras per problem: difficulty (easy | medium | harder) and a one-line real-life framing. Served by GET /problems.

square.framing: A tiling app works out how many tiles a square floor of side n needs.

is_even.framing: A ticket machine checks whether a group can be split into pairs.

greet.framing: A website greets each visitor by name when they log in.

shout.framing: A chat app turns a message into a loud ALL-CAPS announcement.

last_item.framing: A music player shows the last song in your queue.

celsius_to_f.framing: A weather app shows the temperature for visitors who think in Fahrenheit.

sum_to_n.framing: A savings plan: put in 1 coin on day 1, 2 on day 2, ... - how many after n days?

one_to_n.framing: A teacher numbers the seats in a row from 1 to n.

sum_list.framing: A shopping cart adds up the prices of everything in it.

product.framing: A game multiplies the score bonuses you collected in one run.

count_evens.framing: A stock checker counts the shelves holding an even number of boxes.

contains_negative.framing: A bank checks whether any transaction in a statement is a withdrawal.

average.framing: A report card works out the average of your test marks.

percentage.framing: A progress bar shows what percentage of a download is finished.

nth_item.framing: A queue system tells you who is n-th in line (people count from 1).

capitalize_first.framing: A form tidies up a name typed in lower case.

multiples.framing: A bus timetable lists every k-th minute when a bus leaves, up to minute n.

swap_ends.framing: A playlist editor swaps the first and last songs without touching your saved playlist.

replace_at.framing: A word game replaces one letter of a word to make a new word.

append_copy.framing: A to-do app previews a list with one new task, without changing your real list yet.

double_all.framing: A shop shows prices during a 'double points' event without changing the stored prices.

make_grid.framing: A board game sets up an empty rows x cols board where each square is separate.
